newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 15.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French port officials hold talks in Ivory Coast on boosting traffic between the ports of Abidjan and Rouen.
- President Henri Konan Bedie's invitation to World Food Day ceremonies of the Food and Agriculture Organisation in Rome is a mark of recognitin for Ivorian agriculture.
- Start of school year today: Will it be smooth?
- President of National University of Ivory Coast says the country's premier educational institution is tired of producing graduates for the ranks of the unemployed.
- U.N. development agency UNDP and United States Agency for International Development stage seminar in Abidjan on promoting the private sector.
